Digital Opus Engine
Editor

About
Digital Opus Engine

Build 3D games directly in your browser. Local-first. Visual authoring. Play, save, edit and export games without a traditional heavyweight engine install.

Open the Editor
Play Example Games
Explore Features

Best experienced on desktop or tablet with a keyboard/mouse.

WHY DIGITAL OPUS ENGINE
Browser Native

Build directly in the browser -- no download, no install step to get started.

Local First

Projects and imported assets can stay in your browser/local workflow. No cloud account required to build a game.

Visual Authoring

Scene editor, Inspector, Behaviors, Node Graph, Sequences, and Prefabs -- build gameplay without writing engine code.

Standalone Export

Turn a project into a single self-contained playable HTML file, ready to share or host anywhere.

Real 3D Systems

Terrain, lighting, skeletal animation, AI, combat, camera paths and more -- already built in, not a roadmap promise.

LOCAL PRE-RELEASE REVIEW · ALL 28 GAMES RETAINED

Digital Opus rehabilitation

0 Featured · 23 public Sample candidates · 5 internal games.

Screenshots are actual standalone gameplay. Scores are editorial assessments of the rendered result, not automated test scores. Public means included in the local candidate catalog; human screenshot review is still required before release. No deployment has occurred.

Full report · 28-game matrix · Local Engine examples · Screenshot provenance

Replaced ribbon and primitive scenery with ranger, guardian, three beacon courts, connected stone causeway, woods, ruins and sanctuary. Fixed floor lips, authored long-level bounds, fall-to-checkpoint recovery and key-dependent win. Normal play lit all three beacons, collected Vale Key, won at 29.61 simulated seconds with 94 HP, and restarted.
